task: Brave Search API dashboard (Sean's account): create one additional API key on the existing subscription for a second assistant (Jill) and store it

steps.human: Sign in to the Brave Search API dashboard in this tab. Press Done when you see API Keys.

steps.do: API Keys page: report the existing keys (names only) and which subscription/plan they belong to. Change nothing.
Add API key: name it as Jax gives in the chat (e.g. jill), on the existing free plan. Do not change plans or billing.
Reveal the new key and save it with save_secret under the name Jax gives in the chat. Never print it.

accept: A new key named for the assistant exists on the existing plan, and Jax has it in Vaultwarden. No plan or billing change.
notes: If creating a key would require a paid plan or a new card, stop and hand it to Sean.
Sign-in may use a magic link sent to Sean's email; that happens outside the tab.
